message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.62,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked-choice or score vote fairly captures the trade-offs between visibility, recruitment, equipment quality, and pedagogical value, while reducing the risk that the debate winner alone determines the outcome.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Allocate the full budget to an inter-city tournament with buffet and prizes to increase club visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.32},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Allocate the full budget to new pedagogical equipment because the current chessboards, clocks, and teaching materials are worn.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Split the budget equally between a smaller tournament and pedagogical equipment to balance outreach and internal development.","influence":0.28}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The options pursue legitimate but competing objectives, and the evidence does not clearly establish that any single option dominates. A transparent score or ranked vote, preceded by an inventory of unusable equipment and realistic tournament cost estimates, is appropriate. If no option gains broad support, a revised hybrid budget based on verified needs offers the most collaborative and proportionate resolution."}
